-- 1. Full channel breadth + spend by channel/tactic in Display

       COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(Spend) AS total_spend,
       MIN(Date) AS min_date, MAX(Date) AS max_date
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_display
GROUP BY Channel_Group_Name, Media_Tactic, Platform
ORDER BY total_spend DESC;

-- 3. What source views feed the integrated snapshot, and how much spend each contributes
SELECT view_source, Channel_Group_Name,
       COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(Spend) AS total_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
GROUP BY view_source, Channel_Group_Name
ORDER BY view_source, total_spend DESC;

-- 4. Reconciliation: weekly spend for the 3 biddable channel groups in the integrated
-- snapshot, vs. the weekly totals already in your Biddable Spend Bronze table
SELECT Week_Start_Mon, Channel_Group_Name, SUM(Spend) AS integrated_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
WHERE Channel_Group_Name IN ('Programmatic', 'Paid Social', 'Paid Search')
GROUP BY Week_Start_Mon, Channel_Group_Name
ORDER BY Week_Start_Mon DESC, Channel_Group_Name;

-- 5. Weekly Programmatic-only spend from media_analytics_display (true biddable subset)
SELECT Week_Start_Mon,
       CASE WHEN Media_Tactic LIKE 'Programmatic%' THEN 'Programmatic' ELSE 'Direct/Other' END AS biddable_flag,
       Channel_Group_Name, Platform,
       SUM(Spend) AS total_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_display
WHERE Media_Tactic LIKE 'Programmatic%'
GROUP BY Week_Start_Mon, biddable_flag, Channel_Group_Name, Platform
ORDER BY Week_Start_Mon DESC;

-- Programmatic, date-aligned to Bronze's week convention
SELECT Week_End_Sat,
       Channel_Group_Name,
       CASE WHEN Platform IN ('AMZ','AMAZON') THEN 'Amazon DSP' ELSE Platform END AS platform_norm,
       SUM(Spend) AS display_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_display
WHERE Media_Tactic LIKE 'Programmatic%'
GROUP BY Week_End_Sat, Channel_Group_Name, platform_norm
ORDER BY Week_End_Sat DESC;

-- Paid Search, with the engine breakdown via Account_Type
SELECT Week_End_Sat, Account_Type, SUM(Spend) AS integrated_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
WHERE Channel_Group_Name = 'Paid Search'
GROUP BY Week_End_Sat, Account_Type
ORDER BY Week_End_Sat DESC;

-- Paid Social, Facebook + Instagram collapsed to match Bronze's single "Meta" platform
SELECT Week_End_Sat,
       CASE WHEN Channel_Name IN ('Paid Social - Facebook','Paid Social - Instagram') THEN 'Meta'
            ELSE REPLACE(Channel_Name, 'Paid Social - ', '') END AS platform_norm,
       SUM(Spend) AS integrated_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
WHERE Channel_Group_Name = 'Paid Social'
GROUP BY Week_End_Sat, platform_norm
ORDER BY Week_End_Sat DESC;
